question: Why was this group of four phonemes named ūṣma by Bhairava?
premises: There is a group of four phonemes under discussion.
It shines with its own heat.
Bhairava of pure nature declared its name to be ūṣma.
inference: The phoneme group is called ūṣma because its defining quality is self-generated heat or fervor.
plain_english: Bhairava of pure nature declared that this group of four phonemes is called ūṣma, because it shines with its own heat.
